title: Scalar reassociation on a cartesian affine open
statement: Let $R,S$ be commutative rings with an $R$-algebra structure on $S$, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ a scheme morphism, $W\subseteq X$ affine, and $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-pc-scheme]. Use the cartesian base change $X_S$, projections $g,f_S$ of [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. Let $W\prime=g^{-1}W$ and $h:W\prime\leq g^{-1}W$. Set $A=\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_X)$, $B=\Gamma(W\prime,\mathcal O_{X_S})$, with $A\to B$ induced by $g$. Let $\beta:S\to B$ be restriction of the structure map of $f_S$. Restrict the action on $\Gamma(W,M)$ from $A$ to $R$ along $f$. There exists an $S$-linear equivalence $e:S\otimes_R\Gamma(W,M)\simeq B\otimes_A\Gamma(W,M)$ such that $e(b\otimes s)=\beta(b)\otimes s$ for all $b,s$, with the $S$-action on the right restricted along $\beta$. No quasi-coherence, flatness, or nonemptiness is assumed.

proof.text: The cartesian affine ring formula identifies B with S tensor_R A, compatibly with A and S. Tensor associativity and the tensor-unit equivalence identify (S tensor_R A) tensor_A Γ(W,M) with S tensor_R Γ(W,M). The composite is S-linear and sends b tensor s to β(b) tensor s.
